_comment: Clinical-register qualifier clauses for the negative-control pair builder (scripts/build_control_pairs.py). Each is inserted into a clinical prompt immediately before its ', so ' clause, producing a second CLINICAL phrasing that is longer but identical in register. They exist to reproduce the length difference the real clinical-vs-patient pairs carry (patient span longer in 49/50 pairs, +4.02 words mean on pairs_20260710T011743Z) while holding register constant, so the control is no easier than the treatment. Word counts are chosen to bracket that +4. Draft pending domain review, like the urgency tiers.
